title: Make setup path-independent and safer
description: Audit bootstrap/setup entrypoints so they do not rely on the repository living at a fixed path or on fragile cwd assumptions. Replace path-sensitive logic with repo-root discovery, quote paths safely, and document guardrails so setup is safer to run on new machines and CI.
close_reason: Setup script is now path-independent/safer, and shell initialization with EDITOR/VISUAL management was centralized.

title: Standardize install scripts for quality and idempotency
description: Review install/*.sh scripts for inconsistent shell quality, repeated logic, missing safety checks, and non-idempotent behavior. Define a common standard for error handling, quoting, logging, and rerun safety so installs behave predictably across machines.
close_reason: Install scripts standardized with safer shell defaults, better idempotency, and cleaner install/update behavior.

title: Fix GitHub Actions so setup failures are not masked
description: Review CI setup steps and shell pipelines to ensure failures surface correctly instead of being hidden by follow-on commands or permissive defaults. Update workflows so broken setup exits fail the job and make regressions easier to detect.
close_reason: Updated GitHub Actions to stop masking setup failures by using strict install-script mode and direct smoke-test execution.

title: シェルスクリプトを python script にして，全体的にコードを整理する
description:
python script からコマンド実行などを行うようにし，一つの CLI ツール的にする
python script でコマンドを実行する際は，shell command を実行する関数を wrap し，実行前に実行コマンドを log に残すようにして下さい
OS や CI/CD なのかをサブコマンド的に指定して実行できるようにして下さい
変更が大きくなりすぎる場合は，必要な sub task に切り分けて順次修正を行なって下さい

title: Add Linux-focused Docker and CI setup verification environment
description: Create a Linux-focused verification environment for the setup script using Docker and CI. Include a Docker-based smoke test harness for the setup script, shared verification checks reusable across local and CI execution, and CI wiring to run the verification flow. Explicitly scope this work to Linux-focused verification and do not attempt to solve macOS containerization as part of this issue.
close_reason: Added Linux-focused Docker smoke test harness, verification script, and CI job for setup validation.

title: Clean up tmux config duplication and OS-specific clipboard handling
description: Remove duplicated tmux configuration paths and centralize clipboard behavior behind clear OS checks. Keep the core tmux config portable while handling macOS and Linux clipboard integrations explicitly and predictably.
close_reason: Removed duplicate tmux copy binding; clipboard handling now explicitly selects pbcopy, wl-copy, or xclip by environment.

title: Reorganize shell initialization and EDITOR/VISUAL management
description: Clarify shell startup responsibilities across login, interactive, and tool-specific init files. Consolidate EDITOR and VISUAL handling so they are defined in one portable place, avoid conflicting overrides, and make shell startup behavior easier to reason about.
close_reason: Setup script is now path-independent/safer, and shell initialization with EDITOR/VISUAL management was centralized.

title: Update README placeholders and outdated setup instructions
description: Refresh the README so it reflects the current repository layout, actual setup flow, and supported environments. Remove placeholder text, fix stale commands, and make first-run instructions trustworthy for new users.

title: Split portable Neovim config from personal Obsidian and macOS settings
description: Separate generally reusable Neovim defaults from personal workflow integrations such as Obsidian-specific paths and macOS-only behavior. Make the portable baseline safe for other environments while keeping personal extensions opt-in or isolated.
close_reason: Obsidian config isolated behind macOS-only personal module; existing fixed vault paths unchanged.
